summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amendment to its Annual Securities Report (ASR) previously submitted September 18, 2026 to Japan's Kanto Regional Finance Bureau under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Law. The amendment, filed September 29, 2026, corrects a cross-reference in Part I, Corporate Information, VI. Financial Condition, changing the citation of the Ministry of Finance Ordinance provision from item 1 to item 2 of Article 328. No securities, ownership, pricing, board recommendation, or transaction terms are involved; the filing is a routine administrative correction with counsel Anderson Mori Tomotsune listed as attorney-in-fact.
